title: 第一卷 第17章 小爷也有小爷的天理第一卷 第18章 神魔遗迹神庭的来历
lines: ：他猛地再次用力，手中的铁刺径直贯穿了柳晴的上颚，让她再也无法发出清晰的声音，
只能发出呜呜呀呀的闷响，双目赤红地瞪着陈渊，像是见鬼一般。
陈渊这话，简直是大逆不道，一身反骨。
若是传出去，定会惹来神怒！
王德发更是目光一凝，心中狠狠发颤······
他从未在一个人族口中，听到过如此狂妄、如此大逆不道的话！
让神庭的诸神赴死？
他妈的，这小子，简直是活腻歪了！
他正要开口呵斥，突然察觉到四周有身影靠近，目光一凝，随即脸上露出了狂喜之色。
“呵呵，狗屎的天理？掀翻这肮脏的天下？让神庭的诸神赴死？？”
“哈哈哈哈，真是愚蠢得可笑！”
“蝼蚁一般的东西，也敢妄谈撼动天威？
殊不知，在真正的神灵面前，你才是那个狗屎不如的玩意！”
一道浑厚的声音从树林中传出，一行身着黑色劲装的身影，缓缓从昏暗的树林里走了出来。
陈渊瞳孔猛地收缩，目光投向那些脖子上长着鳞片、或是拖着尾巴的奇怪人物。
兽人！
或者说，是十二兽相族之一！
他厉声喝道：“退下！”
“呵呵，有意思，难得有个人族小子，敢对我们无相门如此不敬。”
为首的中年男子冷笑开口，他的脖子上布满鳞片，脸颊上交织着猩红的纹路。
无相门？
陈渊瞳孔又是一缩！
自从醒来之后，这无相门的名号，就早已如雷贯耳。
“莫队长？”
王德发看到来人，顿时松了口气。
来人正是无相门的一名小队长，莫洪。
虽说只是个小队长，却已达到法体境中期，战力几乎凌驾于场中所有人之上。
“交给我，他们，一个都跑不掉。”
莫洪冷笑一声，再次看向陈渊：“人族小子，我让你看看，我们大相帝国所谓的天理！”
说着，他身旁一个拖着尾巴的青年上前一步，对着陈渊亮出一枚令牌。
嗡！
令牌瞬间金光大盛，一股强大的压迫感，骤然笼罩住陈渊和陈昭宁，让两人动弹不得。
陈渊脸色骤变。
“是黄庭级法宝！”
陈昭宁低声惊呼。
陈渊瞳孔骤缩，这所谓的黄庭法宝，应当是指法宝的境界！
可这般威势，竟让他生出无力反抗之心，绝望感瞬间攫住了他。
莫洪看着脸色惨白的陈渊，冷笑道：“人族小子，这就是我们的天理，是神赐下的神律！
在神的面前，你不过是蝼蚁，镇压你，不过翻手之间。”
content_en:
: He suddenly exerted force again, and the iron thorn in his hand penetrated Liu Qing's upper jaw, making her unable to make a clear sound anymore.
He could only make a muffled sound and stared at Chen Yuan with red eyes, as if he had seen a ghost.
Chen Yuan's words were simply treasonous and rebellious.
If word spreads, it will definitely attract the wrath of God!
Wang Defa's eyes narrowed even more, and his heart trembled...
He has never heard such arrogant and rebellious words from a human race!
Let the gods of the Divine Court die?
Damn it, this kid is so tired of living!
He was about to scold him when he suddenly noticed figures approaching from around him. His eyes narrowed, and then a look of ecstasy appeared on his face.
"Haha, what a piece of shit? Overthrow this filthy world? Let the gods of the Divine Court die??"
"Hahahaha, it's so ridiculously stupid!"
"Things like ants dare to talk about shaking the power of heaven?
As everyone knows, in front of the real gods, you are the one who is worse than shit! "
A deep voice came from the woods, and a group of figures in black costumes slowly walked out of the dim woods.
Chen Yuan's pupils shrank suddenly and he looked at the strange figures with scales on their necks or tails.
Orcs!
In other words, it is one of the twelve beast-like tribes!
He shouted sternly: "Back off!"
"Haha, it's interesting. It's rare for a clan boy to dare to be so disrespectful to our Wuxiang Sect."
The leading middle-aged man sneered. His neck was covered with scales and his cheeks were intertwined with scarlet lines.
No phase gate?
Chen Yuan's pupils shrank again!
Ever since he woke up, the name of the Wuxiang Sect has already been heard like thunder.
"Captain Mo?"
Wang Defa was relieved when he saw the person coming.
The person who came was none other than Mo Hong, a squad leader from the Wuxiang Sect.
Although he is only a squad leader, he has reached the middle stage of the legal body realm, and his combat power is superior to almost everyone in the field.
"Leave it to me, none of them can escape."
Mo Hong sneered and looked at Chen Yuan again: "Human boy, let me show you the so-called natural principles of our Prime Minister Empire!"
As he spoke, a young man with a tail beside him stepped forward and showed a token to Chen Yuan.
Buzz!
The token instantly glowed with golden light, and a strong sense of oppression suddenly enveloped Chen Yuan and Chen Zhaoning, making them unable to move.
"This..."
Chen Yuan's expression suddenly changed.
"It's a Huangting-level magic weapon!"
Chen Zhaoning exclaimed in a low voice.
Chen Yuan's pupils shrank suddenly. This so-called Huangting magic weapon should refer to the realm of magic weapons!
But such power made him feel powerless to resist, and a sense of despair instantly seized him.
Mo Hong looked at the pale Chen Yuan and sneered: "Human boy, this is our heavenly law, the divine law given by God!
In front of God, you are nothing but an ant. Suppressing you is just a matter of seconds. "
